item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: Earth, Sun and the apparent motion of the sky
item.stem: Meera lives in Delhi and her cousin Ravi lives in Singapore, close to the Equator. Both note the length of daytime on 21 June. Which statement about their observations is correct?

options.A: Meera and Ravi both record about 12 hours of daytime, because day length is the same everywhere on a given day
options.B: Meera records her longest day of the year, while Ravi's day stays close to 12 hours
options.C: Ravi records his longest day of the year, while Meera's day stays close to 12 hours
options.D: Meera records her shortest day of the year, because June is winter in the Northern Hemisphere
